purpose: Original combat head source sheets; two designs per species; no original game images used as generation inputs.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original modular COMBAT SPRITE HEADS for a very low-resolution tactical RPG, NOT portraits.
Create a single horizontal sprite source sheet with TWO distinct tiny head designs, side by side, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background. No text, labels, borders, grid, checkerboard pattern, shadows, torsos, shoulders, clothing, or extra objects. Separate the two heads with plenty of clear transparent space. Each head is adult, faces RIGHT in a side/three-quarter combat view, and ends in a small flat neck base. Both heads have the same apparent size and baseline.
Critical style: extremely coarse, deliberately minimal pixel art, a face that can remain readable as ONLY 5 to 8 logical pixels wide and 6 to 8 logical pixels high. Use large square color blocks, hard pixel edges, flat colors, no gradients, no antialiasing, no dither, no smooth illustration, no detailed eyes or teeth. Render the tiny pixel designs enlarged. About 6 to 8 chunky blocks should span each head, not dozens. Silhouette and two-tone species cues must do all the work. Limit every head to THREE opaque flat colors: the given skin color, given dark feature color, and pure black #000000 for the outline/eye. Everything outside the heads must have alpha zero. No white background. Make wholly original designs without using an existing game character.
Subject: two adult Tiefling combat heads. Red skin #FF5555, deep red #AA0000 hair and horns, black outline/eye. Left: short swept-back hair with two compact upward horn pixels. Right: short dark hair with a backward-curving horn silhouette. Infernal horn silhouettes must be obvious even at seven pixels across. Keep neck at bottom center, nose facing right. Horns count within the tiny head bounds.

Subject: two adult Goliath combat heads. Light blue/slate skin represented by #5555FF, dark gray #555555 birthmark/brow pixels, black eye/outline. Bald or closely shaven, strong brows and angular jaws, simple dark geometric facial markings. Left: one dark diagonal temple marking. Right: dark brow band and cheek mark. CRITICAL: ordinary HUMAN HEAD SIZE, not giant or enlarged. Each complete head silhouette including neck must work in FIVE logical pixels wide and SIX logical pixels tall. No horns, helmet, beard, or oversized skull. The taller goliath body does not enlarge the head.
